KEN.note: Article is about voice AI for Kenyan speech; no government body use of AI is stated.

facts.fact: IEEE Spectrum reports the African Next Voices project, backed by a US$2.2 million Gates Foundation grant, has Maseno University's Centre for Applied AI collecting Kenyan speech, roughly 3,000 hours of transcribed speech according to its lead Lilian Wanzare.
IEEE Spectrum reports Nairobi startup MsingiAI has piloted its Nia Voice Agent, a Swahili speech AI, with farmers in western Kenya.
